'''Ferreges''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] hired by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] [[Hanos Darr]] and [[Zaz Kamiroz]]. She was a tall, [[Color/Legends|blonde]] woman with exotic features and was totally ruthless and unemotional.
